summary: Frontend-only test of the reworked 'Loan Eligibility Calculation' waterfall on the Decision tab for RiskRadar Strong Pvt Ltd. All 6 expandable step rows render, expand/collapse works, binding highlight + chip 'Binding: Policy maximum' shown, flow summary at bottom shows Requested / Ceilings / Binding / Recommended / decision + EMI/FOIR/interest line with real numbers, no React hook errors, Decision Trace tab still works.
action_items: MINOR / DOC ONLY: review_request mentioned step testids end with a trailing dash (e.g. 'wf-step-policy-maximum-'), but actual DOM testids are without trailing dash (e.g. 'wf-step-policy-maximum'). Not a functional bug – just update the spec/prefix documentation for future test agents. Behaviour verified with prefix match.
critical_code_review_comments: openStep useState is correctly declared at top of DecisionTab (before early returns) — no hook-order violation observed.
Detail panel testids (wf-detail-*) are only rendered when expanded, which is fine but callers should query by prefix or after click.
Formula/Calculation/Inputs come from backend eligibility_waterfall entries – frontend gracefully renders whatever backend provides.
seed_data_creation: None (used existing RiskRadar Strong Pvt Ltd application LS-2026-00154 with existing REJECT decision, binding=Policy maximum, recommended ₹50.00 L)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Decision tab waterfall verified: testids are eligibility-waterfall, binding-constraint, wf-step-{slug} (NO trailing dash), wf-detail-{slug} (rendered only when expanded), eligibility-flow-summary. Binding row for Policy maximum shows amber BINDING chip. Header chip reads 'Binding: Policy maximum'. Flow summary shows: Requested ₹80.00 L → Ceilings computed → Binding: Policy maximum ₹50.00 L → Recommended ₹50.00 L → REJECT + 'At 20.00% for 48 months → EMI ₹1,52,152 · post-loan FOIR 19.6% · total interest ₹23.03 L · total repayment ₹73.03 L'. Policy maximum detail formula: 'min(product absolute cap, annual turnover × turnover multiple)'; calculation: 'min(₹50.00 L, ₹215.00 L × 0.35) = min(₹50.00 L, ₹75.25 L) = ₹50.00 L'. No hook error / blank screen. Cash Flow, Recommended Loan Structure, Override button, Trace tab all render.
